messages:
maria: quick check-in — thinking about emitting incremental/partial-credit events for streaming and other long-lived requests instead of waiting for finalization. goal: reflect near-real-time balances and reduce big tail adjustments. @kevin @sophia any blockers? :thinking:
kevin: love the UX win. main concerns: (1) dedupe when final arrives, (2) write amplification to the ledger and indexing costs.
sophia: dedupe can be handled if partials include a pointer and finalization id. suggestion: partials get `provisional: true` + `provenance_id`; final event references those partial ids and is authoritative. canonicalizer can mark partials superseded during settle.
tim: ops concerns: ordering for client-visible balances (need per-session monotonic seq), and cross-region reordering for long sessions. if a late microbatch arrives, do we risk negative corrections?
maria: propose per-session seq + event_id; ledger treats partials as provisional. API returns provisional balance with a `provisional` flag until final settled. finalizer reconciles and flips to settled.
kevin: OK. SLA questions: how long do partials stay provisional? recommend a default 30s settle target for hosted; Dedicated customers can configure tighter/broader windows. also outline backlog behavior if finalizer falls behind.
sophia: sample event schema for discussion (we're just embedding example JSON as text, not changing message schema in this thread):
{
  "event_type": "partial_credit",
  "event_id": "evt_p_01",
  "session_id": "sess-42",
  "seq": 7,
  "tokens": 120,
  "provisional": true,
  "provenance_id": "prov-xyz",
  "timestamp": 4319998990
}
and finalizer emits:
{
  "event_type": "final_credit",
  "event_id": "evt_f_01",
  "session_id": "sess-42",
  "seq": 7,
  "tokens": 125,
  "provisional": false,
  "finalizes": ["evt_p_01"],
  "timestamp": 4319999040
}
kevin: dedupe model seems solid. we should record the mapping in an index for fast lookups during reconcile to avoid full scans. cost impact: ballpark +10-20% storage/write.
maria: operational playbook idea: if finalizer backlog grows above threshold, mark new partials as provisional-only and pause final issuance until backlog clears; alert SRE and route to degraded-mode. we should also surface provisional vs settled in Console and API.
sophia: telemetry: tag partials with sampling fingerprint and retention hints to help downstream compaction and audits. also include an append-only audit trail so finance can reconstruct any settled number.
tim: failure modes: network partitions between regions could reorder seqs — include `session_origin` and rely on leader-election per-session to guarantee monotonic seqs. fallback: if seq gap detected, mark session in 'reconciling' state and expose to support.
metering-bot: NOTICE: ingest schema registry bump required (v3) for `provisional` + `provenance_id` fields. Please open RFC and coordinate migration plan.
maria: i'll open RFC (w/ reconciliation recipe, storage cost estimate, SLA defaults, and playbook). linking when ready. thanks all :thumbsup:
thread_summary: short thread proposing incremental partial-credit events for streaming usage; covers dedupe/finalization design, per-session seqs, provisional vs settled states, SLA defaults (30s), operational playbook for finalizer backlog, schema bump, telemetry for audits, and next steps to open RFC
